title: ProCompNav: Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment for Ambiguous User Queries
abstract: arXiv:2605.06223v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Natural-language instance navigation becomes challenging when the initial user request does not uniquely specify the target instance. A practical agent should reduce the user's burden by actively asking only the information needed to distinguish the target from similar distractors, rather than requiring a detailed description upfront. Existing approaches often fall short of this goal by mistaking distractors that strongly match the accumulated information about the target provided by the user. As a result, despite the dialogue, the agent may still fail to distinguish the target from distractors, leading to premature decisions and lengthy user responses. We propose Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment (ProCompNav), a two-stage framework that first constructs a candidate pool and then identifies the target through Recursive Comparative Judgment (RCJ). translated_title: ProCompNav：面向模糊用户查询的基于比较判断的主动实例导航
translated_abstract: 当用户的初始请求无法唯一确定目标实例时，自然语言实例导航就变得具有挑战性。一个实用的智能体应该通过主动询问仅需区分目标与相似干扰项的信息来减轻用户负担，而不是要求用户预先提供详细的描述。然而，现有方法往往无法达到这一目标，它们会误将那些与用户所提供的关于目标的累积信息高度匹配的干扰项当作目标。其结果是，即使经过了对话交互，智能体仍可能无法将目标与干扰项区分开，从而导致过早做出决策，并需要用户给出冗长的回复。我们提出了基于比较判断的主动实例导航方法ProCompNav，这是一个两阶段框架：首先构建候选池，然后通过递归比较判断（RCJ）来识别目标实例。RCJ通过选择属性-值对迭代地缩小候选池……
tldr: 提出ProCompNav两阶段框架，利用递归比较判断（RCJ）主动询问区分性信息，逐步缩小候选池，从而在模糊查询场景下准确识别目标实例，避免将强匹配的干扰项误认为目标。
en_tdlr: ProCompNav is a two-stage framework that employs Recursive Comparative Judgment (RCJ) to proactively ask discriminative questions and iteratively narrow a candidate pool, accurately identifying target instances under ambiguous user queries while avoiding mistaking strongly-matching distractors for the target.
